A LOCAL DESKTOP APP

Turn receipts into room records.

For renters and homeowners who need purchase details after a move, repair, or insurance question.

Try it with sample data
See three demo records right away.
Demo records stay separate.
Receipt text is read on your computer.
$29 once for unlimited receipts.
Identify the line. Check the detail. Place it in a room.

HOW IT WORKS

Read, check, and file each receipt.
01
Add receipt photos

Choose receipt photos in the desktop app.

02
Check each line

Correct item names, prices, rooms, and warranty dates before saving.

03
Find records later

Search by room or item. Download a spreadsheet with payment details removed.

DESKTOP WALKTHROUGH

See the receipt workflow before installing.

The four frames show loading, review, room assignment, and export.

1. Load demo records
Open three reviewed records without touching your own.
2. Review receipt lines
Check names, prices, and which lines to save.
3. Place each item
Give every line its room, category, and warranty date.
4. Search and export
Find a record later and download a spreadsheet with payment details removed.
LOCAL

PRIVACY

Receipt work stays on your computer.

The desktop app reads receipt text on your computer. Read the privacy note for storage and paid-version details.

Read the privacy note

PRICE

Three receipts are free.

The free app includes search, spreadsheet download, and printable output. Pay $29 once to add unlimited receipts and use backup files.

ONE TIME
